= Azure CosmosDB
:artifactid: camel-azure-cosmosdb-starter

Store, read and query items in Azure Cosmos DB, and receive the changes of a container from its change feed.

== What's inside

* xref:{csb-camel-components}::azure-cosmosdb-component.adoc[Azure CosmosDB component], URI syntax: `azure-cosmosdb:databaseName/containerName`

Please refer to the above links for usage and configuration details.

== Maven coordinates

[source,xml]
----
<dependency>
    <groupId>org.apache.camel.springboot</groupId>
    <artifactId>camel-azure-cosmosdb-starter</artifactId>
</dependency>
----
